name: Mimar Sinan Mosque
scope: The 2012 Mimar Sinan Mosque in Ataşehir, with its hexagonal central dome group, four three-balcony minarets and open courtyard arcade.

originalReview.notes: The exact original shows the mosque from the east with pale limestone, blue-grey seam-ribbed dome, three muqarnas-supported balconies and fine spires, along with its lower arched arcades and smaller cupolas. The unrelated distant apartment towers are excluded.

review.method: Photographer’s original Qualla photo and verified native first-party public-domain release.
review.notes: The exact Qualla image matches the native Commons file and the photographer’s own original Flickr bytes. The signed photographer is independently named in the Flickr author and creator fields, where the original is designated Public Domain Work. Commons links the same author and file in its passed review. Other views with attribution-sharealike or uncertain terms were excluded.
